name: public-grievance-ai-assistant
description: Public Grievance AI Assistant (Problem ID: HACK-P438) - Full-Stack Hackathon Project

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: College Hackathon Team
